sentences.Ja, og det er vår nå. Når har du bursdag: Yes, and it's spring now. When is your birthday, Hawa?
sentences.Jeg har bursdag om høsten. Jeg er født 1: My birthday is in autumn. I was born on 18 September. When were you born, Biniam?
sentences.Jeg er født 6. januar, og du Håvard, hvi: I was born on 6 January, and you, Håvard, what date were you born?
sentences.27. april? Har du bursdag i dag?: 27 April? Is it your birthday today?
We're talking about dates of birth.
sentences.Jeg er født 18.9., og Biniam er født 6.1: I was born on 18/9, and Biniam was born on 6/1.
sentences.Vi spiser kake og drikker kaffe i klasse: We're eating cake and drinking coffee in class.
sentences.Jeg har lyst til å spise mer kake. Smile: I want to eat more cake. Smiley face.
